is_streaming.description: True only while the session's run is a live stream on this server.

source_kind.description: The session's source family. `is_cli_session` is true only for `cli` and `claude_code`.

is_messaging_session.description: `source_kind` is `messaging`: a gateway chat (Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, …) the server imports before Web continues it.

sort_ts.description: Epoch seconds the session sorts and date-buckets by: `last_message_at`, else `updated_at`, else `created_at`.

read_only.description: The session cannot be modified from Web: a read-only import, a view-only subagent child, or a foreign session whose owner refuses claiming.

read_only_reason.description: Server-owned reason this session is display-only or its ownership cannot be verified.

restarting.description: The owning gateway is restarting once this turn ends; sending waits until it is back.

reasoning.description: The level chosen with this model; a confirmed resend carries it again.

queued_input_count.description: TAL-1531: how many inputs `admissions` shows, outcome-unknown ones included; every client shows this count. Absent from older servers.

connection.description: TAL-1317: the owner's open connection operation, restored on attach. Absent outside a session view.

reasoning_control.description: Absent when the owner reports no level (an older owner or server) or outside a session view: the chat offers no picker.

reasoning_effort.description: The level this chat runs now, clamped for its route. Null is the provider default.

actions.description: What this client may ask the owner now. Empty while the owner cannot take a change.

deferred.description: A pick the owner holds for the end of the running turn; `reasoning_effort` stays the actual level. Null effort is a held reset.

can_branch.description: Web may branch this session: never a subagent child or an ownership-locked session; other read-only sessions only when they are cron runs.

can_pin.description: Web may pin or unpin this session: never a subagent child or a session locked by canonical ownership or unreadable ownership storage.

can_archive.description: Web may archive or unarchive this session: never a subagent child or a session locked by canonical ownership or unreadable ownership storage.

can_delete.description: Web may delete this session: never a read-only session (a read-only import, a view-only subagent child, or a foreign session whose owner refuses claiming).

can_duplicate.description: Web may duplicate this session: it has a WebUI copy, is not a subagent child, and is not locked by canonical ownership or unreadable ownership storage.

can_share.description: Web may create or refresh a public share of this session: never a Claude Code import (TAL-551).

active_stream_id.description: The live stream id; non-null only while `is_streaming` is true.

sidebar_group.description: TAL-1534: the sidebar group `GET /api/sessions` and its sidebar search file the row under; null for an archived row outside `scheduled` and `webhook`. Other routes omit it.

sidebar_parent_session_id.description: TAL-1151: the listed row this subagent row nests under (its nearest non-subagent ancestor, a compressed parent by its lineage tip, same profile); null when that row is not in the same response. A nested row files in its parent's project and source tab. `GET /api/sessions` and its sidebar search set it; older servers and other routes omit it.

sidebar_source.description: TAL-1863: the source tab the row files in, the one verdict `webui_session_count`, `cli_session_count` and the `sidebar_source` request filter read. A subagent row takes its parent's tab, listed or not, in its own profile; with no resolvable parent it keeps its own (`webui`). `is_cli_session` stays false for a subagent. `GET /api/sessions` and its sidebar search set it; other routes omit it.

pinned_count.description: TAL-1531: how many of `tasks` are pinned; every client shows this count. Absent from older servers.

allowed_choices.description: The answers this approval accepts; empty when its owner offered none Talaria can send. Absent (older servers, direct sessions) accepts all four.

can_deny_with_instruction.description: This approval offers deny and its turn can take a steer, so a deny may carry an instruction. Absent means no.

tool_call_id.description: The running tool call this approval holds, the `id` of its `tool` frame. Absent when the Agent names none.

answered.description: TAL-1271: a gateway-owned batch question the owner already holds an answer for; it stays editable until the last answer.

origin.description: The page origin the login is saved for (`vault_save_login`).

hint.description: Where the code was sent, when the Agent says (`vault_code`).

secret.description: The environment secret the agent asks for (`agent_secret`).

env_name.description: The profile `.env` name the answer is saved under.

purpose.description: Why the agent asks, as it sent it.

optional.description: The agent can continue without it.

existed_before.description: The name already has a value, which a save replaces.

fields.description: The inputs to show; empty when this viewer cannot answer.

can_answer.description: False when this viewer may not answer: only the server owner answers an `agent_secret`. Absent means true.

timeout_at.description: Unix seconds when the Agent stops waiting.

instruction_outcome.description: Where a deny's instruction went: into the running turn, queued next in this session, or unknown because the steer lost its acknowledgment (it may have landed, so it is not sent again).
